integrity: Proof gives universal sign classification; finite checker is corroborative, not infinite certification. Public motivating preprint arXiv:0911.5672v1 first posted 2009-11-30; earlier published genetics formulas are cited without inventing an exact daily first-public date.
scientific_limitations: Neutral Kingman coalescent of three contemporaneous gene copies
Constant infinite-sites mutation rate, unnormalized expected SFS
Only intact two-epoch swaps; no recombination, selection, ancestral uncertainty, or finite-sample inference
Priority risk: general SFS formulas and potential unstated published rearrangement corollaries
title: A universal epoch-swap sign law for three-sequence neutral polymorphism
